test_policy.notes: Test scores are optional for an admissions decision, though a few majors and scholarships require them; superscoring applies. Climb Higher Level 1 needs ACT 30 / SAT 1360 plus a 3.8 GPA.

requirements.notes: International fee $75 (WV residents $20, out-of-state $65). Freshman applicants need a converted GPA of at least 2.5 on a 4.0 scale; some majors need higher GPAs for direct entry. Unofficial transcripts are enough to apply; no essays or recommendations are required (first-time freshman page). Rolling admissions.

deadlines.label: International fall application deadline ('apply by'); all documents due July 1
deadlines.notes: The international page lists Fall: apply by June 1, all documents by July 1, without printing a year, so fall 2027 is assumed. Spring: Oct. 1 / Nov. 1. Domestic first-time freshman deadline is Aug. 1 (fall), Dec. 1 (spring); the page encourages early application because some majors are selective or capacity-limited.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt: citizens of listed countries (e.g. Australia, Canada, India, Nigeria, Pakistan, UK, Ghana, Kenya, Nepal, South Africa), IB Diploma holders, GCSE/GCE English A-C (or 4-9), 24+ transferable credits in a qualifying country, or students meeting academic admission while pursuing/earning a U.S. high school diploma. SAT EBRW 570 or ACT English 24 are also accepted. WVU does not accept expired scores, General IELTS or institutional TOEFL (ITP); WVU can check scores directly so official reports are often unnecessary.

english.notes: Exams through January 2026 (Home Edition accepted). English Language Pathways Program range 61-78.
Exams after January 2026 (Home Edition accepted); the page does not name the 1-6 scale. Pathways range 3.0-3.5.
Academic IELTS. Pathways 5.5-6.0 with no section below 5.5. No sub-score requirement for regular admission. TOEFL Essentials 9.0 also accepted.
PTE Academic and PTE Express. Pathways range 44-52.

aid.notes: International students are automatically considered for the Climb Higher Scholarship on admission (non-resident Morgantown amounts for students admitted for 2026-27: Level 1 GPA 3.8+ and SAT 1360/ACT 30 = $17,000/yr; Level 2 GPA 3.8+ = $14,000; Level 3 GPA 3.5-3.79 = $11,000; Level 4 GPA 3.0-3.49 = $8,000; renewable up to 8 semesters). The 2027-28 page says the non-resident amounts are still to be determined. University Merit scholarship needs a separate application. English Language Pathways Program and Intensive English Program offer conditional admission for Morgantown applicants. The PDF does not show whether need-based institutional aid is open to nonresidents.
